correctness.rationale: Williams' mixed inequality follows by integrating fiber concavity g(y)≥2a(1-p_B(y)) to get volume≥(2a/3)area(B), and projected covering-density bound ρ²area(B)≥detΣ. Both are equal iff every fiber length has the specified radial profile and ρ B+Σ lattice-tiles onefold. Fedorov gives planar B a parallelogram or centrally symmetric hexagon; affine radial fibers force K to have exactly 6 or 8 extreme vertices. For normalized hexagonal tile H with q=max(|2u+w|,|u+2w|,|u-w|), exact rational fan gradients show q±τf convex iff |τ|≤1; the odd fan centers are uniquely linear shear ℓ plus τf. Area(H)=1 and q(z)≥2 for every nonzero integer lattice point establish tiling, λ1=ρ=1; volume=2/3. Nonzero τ yields noncoplanar 6-vertex equator. Independently computed all six rational fan vertices, polygon area, gradients/convexity for τ=-1,0,1,±3/2, and lattice obstruction in a 31×31 integer box; the infinite tiling exclusion follows from the three integral linear forms argument.
